name: Ve Wong Corporation
summary: Ve Wong Corporation engages in the production and sale of monosodium glutamate, soy sauce, instant noodles, canned food, and beverages in Taiwan, Thailand, and Vietnam. The company offers canned foods, including pickled cucumber, pickled lettuce, chili turnip strips, strip cucumber with perilla, ginger crisp, chili bamboo shoots, fermented tofu, and garlic chili sauce; canned beverages, such as asparagus drink, honey herbal jelly drink, mixed sweet porridge chinese style, lemon tea, peach drink, guava drink, paochong tea, and mixed fruit and vegetable juice; and soy sauce, thick soy sauce, and vegetarian oyster sauce shiitake flavor.
